title: Separation properties of a hybrid point process with determinantal radii and uniform arguments
summary: We recently characterized the almost sure separation of determinantal point processes $Λ_φ$ in the plane associated with Fock spaces $\mathcal F_φ$ with doubling weights $φ$. We also showed that, as expected, a more restrictive condition is required to characterize the almost surely separated Poisson processes with the same first intensity as $Λ_φ$. To gain further insight into this difference in behavior, we focus on radial weights $φ$ and introduce a hybrid process $Λ_φ^M=\{r_j e^{iθ_j}\}_{j}$, where the moduli $r_j$ are taken from $Λ_φ$, while the arguments $θ_j$ are chosen independently…
